audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1-4 of the level chart disagree with the page's own whys text: the chart gives Nautilus levels 2, 3 and 4-5 outright and calls level 6 a skill row, while the prose says level 2 is 'roughly even farming', level 3 'trades stay even', 4-5 'turns extended trades against you' and level 6 'out-grind your low base damage'.
audit.why: The packet chart reads Nautilus / Skill / Skill / Nasus / Nasus / Nasus / Nasus, which matches the prose exactly. Wither at level 3 is the flip point the page already describes.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 2 to Skill, rows 3 and 4 to Nasus, in both layers as one atomic group, with ratings moved to match.

audit.why: Spikes are right and unusually well-chosen: your level 1-2 pre-Wither window, his level 3 Wither, his Sheen first item, his 2+ item stacked Q. Matches both kits.
audit.corrected: Unchanged; the chart now agrees with them instead of contradicting spikes[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: Wither is described only as 'a slow' with no cooldown number, and Siphoning Strike's auto-attack reset is never mentioned even though it is the tell for his burst.
audit.why: Wither is 15/14/13/12/11s and 700 range — the single number that decides when you may commit. Siphoning Strike (7.5s at rank 1, falling to 3.5s, and shorter still inside Fury of the Sands) is an auto reset, so the damage arrives on the wind-up, not on a visible cast.
audit.corrected: Wither is 15s at rank 1 — commit inside that window only. Watch his auto wind-up: Siphoning Strike resets the attack, so the big hit lands early.

audit.whatIsWrong: Dredge Line's terrain behaviour is never used. Colliding with terrain pulls Nautilus toward it, which is a gap-close Wither cannot take away.
audit.why: Wither strips your movement speed, so a hook that moves you rather than him is the one approach tool the slow does not answer. The mirror audit records the same mechanic from Nasus's side.
audit.corrected: Hook terrain to close through Wither, then chain the slow and knockup.

audit.why: 66.67% over 15 games. The packet defect calls the Nasus-heavy chart a contradiction, but the chart tracks stage ownership, not game outcome — Nautilus wins the early stages and games end before Nasus's stacks do.

edits.before: His Wither comes online and slows your hook follow-through to a crawl — his base tankiness turns extended trades against you.
edits.after: Wither lands at 3 and slows your hook follow-through to a crawl — it is 15s at rank 1, so commit only inside that window.

edits.before: At 3 his Wither flips the lane — the instant you hook, he point-and-clicks your attack speed and movement to nothing and your follow-up stalls out. Your R at 6 is still a guaranteed pick on paper, but he just walks up, slows you, and out-sustains the trade with lifesteal while Spirit Fire chews your armor. Only commit an all-in if his Wither is on cooldown; otherwise bait it, eat the slow, and look for a gank rather than a solo kill. Your damage is already plateauing while his only grows.
edits.after: At 3 his Wither flips the lane — the instant you hook, he point-and-clicks your attack speed and movement to nothing and your follow-up stalls out. Your R at 6 is still a guaranteed pick on paper, but he walks up, slows you, and out-sustains on Soul Eater lifesteal while Spirit Fire chews your armor. Watch his auto wind-up rather than a cast: Siphoning Strike is an attack reset, so the big hit arrives early. Only all-in inside Wither's 15s; otherwise bait it and take the gank.

edits.before: Use E slow and R knockup to set up your jungler repeatedly before his scaling comes online
edits.after: Hook terrain to close through Wither, then chain E slow and R knockup for your jungler

notes: Chart rows 1-4 flipped in both layers as one atomic group to match the packet chart and the page's own whys. Left alone deliberately (same call as the mirror): both layers tell the player Nasus must not sit behind his caster minions against the hook. Dredge Line's minion-collision behaviour is not in Riot's text, so the claim is unverified in either direction — do not harden it without a source.
